definition: a tall iced drink of gin, lemon and soda
description: At a rooftop bar at sunset with a city skyline and strings of bulbs overhead, a young woman bartender with a high ponytail and a black T-shirt pours soda into a tall ice-filled glass topped with a lemon slice, adds a red cherry and slides the drink across the marble bar to a man in a denim jacket. He takes it, grins and drinks through a straw. A metal shaker, a jigger, halved lemons, a plate of lemon slices and a bowl of cherries stand on the bar, and a crowd drinks behind.

de.answer: Er nippt durch einen Strohhalm an einem Collins.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está bebiendo a sorbos un collins con una pajita.
phrases: beber a sorbos con una pajita
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il sirote un collins avec une paille.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
